executive_summary: The speaker reflects on overcoming a health crisis during the pandemic, highlighting global challenges like geopolitical conflicts and climate change. They argue for a new, more immersive internet era and emphasize the role of open-source tools like Blender. The talk questions who should lead internet development, advocating for inclusivity and open standards over corporate dominance.

summary_points.text: The speaker suggests that the next internet could be more immersive and 3D, potentially transforming how we interact online.
Open-source tools like Blender are highlighted as potential solutions for developing the next internet, though their small scale limits their impact.
The speaker questions who should lead the development of the next internet, emphasizing the need for inclusivity and avoiding corporate dominance.
The speaker recommends trusting open-source communities over corporations for the development of the next internet.

takeaways.title: The Importance of Open Standards for the Next Internet
takeaways.description: The speaker highlights the necessity of open, accessible standards to ensure the next internet remains inclusive and not dominated by a few large corporations.
takeaways.why_it_matters: Open standards are crucial for preventing corporate control and ensuring the internet remains a shared, accessible resource for all.

takeaways.title: Blender's Potential Role in Internet Development
takeaways.description: Blender, a small open-source tool, may have a critical role in shaping the next internet, despite its current limitations in the corporate landscape.
takeaways.why_it_matters: Blender's open-source nature could enable broader participation in internet development, even if it is not yet widely recognized or adopted.

takeaways.title: Challenges of Corporate Dominance in Internet Development
takeaways.description: The speaker warns that the current corporate landscape may hinder the development of an inclusive internet, favoring control by a few dominant entities.
takeaways.why_it_matters: Corporate dominance threatens the diversity and accessibility of the internet, making it essential to challenge this trend.

takeaways.title: The Limitations of Small Tools in the Corporate Landscape
takeaways.description: The speaker suggests that small tools like Blender may struggle to make a significant impact in the current corporate-dominated internet environment.
takeaways.why_it_matters: Small, open-source tools face challenges in competing with large corporate entities, which may limit their influence on internet development.

takeaways.title: The Need for Inclusivity in Internet Development
takeaways.description: The speaker stresses that the next internet must be designed to be inclusive, ensuring that all users have equal access and participation.
takeaways.why_it_matters: Inclusivity is essential for the internet to serve as a platform for global collaboration and innovation.

chapters.title: Blender's 20th Anniversary and Personal Health Update
chapters.description: The speaker begins by celebrating Blender's 20th anniversary as open source and shares personal news about their recovery from a health crisis during the pandemic.

chapters.title: Reflections on a Health Crisis and Global Challenges
chapters.description: The speaker reflects on their health struggles from three years prior, contrasting their personal experience with global challenges like the pandemic, geopolitical conflicts, and climate change.

chapters.title: The Metaverse and Corporate Influence on the Internet's Future
chapters.description: The speaker discusses the Metaverse and the role of large corporations in shaping the next internet, questioning who should lead its development.

highlights.title: The next internet could be 3D
highlights.description: The speaker explains that the internet may evolve to become more immersive with 3D engines, allowing users to experience the internet in three dimensions.
highlights.quote: The internet will become 3D, or more 3D, and we probably will start browsing

highlights.title: Blender's small scale limits its impact
highlights.description: The speaker notes that Blender is currently too small to have a meaningful impact in the corporate-driven development of the next internet, despite its potential.
highlights.quote: Blender is still super small, and I don't think I can make any difference there.

highlights.title: Trust open-source communities over corporations
highlights.description: The speaker suggests that open-source communities, like Blender, should be trusted to develop the next internet rather than large corporations.
highlights.quote: because who do you really trust to make the next Internet?

topics.name: 3D Internet and Metaverse
topics.description: stated: The talk discusses the concept of a 3D internet and the Metaverse as interconnected digital spaces.

topics.name: Climate Change
topics.description: stated: The talk addresses the challenges and impacts of climate change on the environment and society.

topics.name: Open-Source
